source: AI Video Bootcamp - Kling AI Cinematic Camera Movement Toolkit

rules.lead_with_camera: Always start your prompt with the camera angle and build from there, this way Kling recognizes it immediately.
rules.think_ahead: Always create your images in a way that will complement the camera movement. If you say 'tracking over the shoulder' but there is no character in your scene, or 'the camera dives underwater' but there is no water nearby, Kling will get confused.

subject.label: a person in frame
subject.fix: describe who is in the shot in the Subject tab

shoulder.label: the subject seen from behind, shoulder or head in frame
shoulder.fix: the still must be shot from behind the character, not face-on

space.label: room around the subject for the camera to travel
space.fix: use a wider shot - 'environmental' rather than a tight portrait

environment.label: a described setting
environment.fix: fill in the Setting field; the move reveals the surroundings

water.label: water in or near the scene
water.fix: the setting must mention water - a lake, the sea, a pool

face.label: the face clearly visible
face.fix: use a portrait or talking-head shot so there is a face to push into

foreground.label: objects between the camera and the subject
foreground.fix: mention foreground detail - crowds, tents, branches, doorways

height.label: sky, height or something to descend from
height.fix: the setting needs vertical scale - outdoors, a tall space

object.label: a specific object to circle or focus on
object.fix: name the object in the Action field

obstacle.label: something for the camera to emerge from behind
obstacle.fix: mention a tree, wall, doorway or pillar in the setting

atmosphere.label: fog, smoke, mist or dust to move through
atmosphere.fix: add the element to the setting - mist, smoke, haze

portal.label: a mirror, window or doorway to pass through
portal.fix: name the portal in the setting

second_subject.label: two people in frame
second_subject.fix: the still needs a second character

handheld.name: Handheld Camera Movement
handheld.does: Simulates a camera held by a human. Creates realism, tension or chaos.
handheld.example: first-person handheld camera walking through a destroyed city street at sunset, slight camera shake, rubble and fire in the background, cinematic lighting

dolly-in.name: Slow Dolly In
dolly-in.does: Moves closer to the subject to build emotional intensity or focus.
dolly-in.detail: camera begins far and pushes in
dolly-in.example: cinematic slow dolly in toward a crying soldier sitting alone in the rain, camera begins far and pushes in toward his face, moody lighting

dolly-out.name: Slow Dolly Out
dolly-out.does: Moves away from the subject. Shows isolation, departure, or reveals the environment.
dolly-out.example: slow dolly out from a woman standing on a cliff overlooking a vast ocean, hair blowing in the wind, wide cinematic shot

track-behind.name: Smooth Tracking Behind Character
track-behind.does: Follows a character from behind. Immersive - the viewer walks with them.
track-behind.example: camera smoothly tracking behind a cloaked traveler walking through a snowy forest, first-person style, ambient wind

over-shoulder.name: Over-the-Shoulder Shot
over-shoulder.does: Camera sits behind a character facing their view, shoulder in frame. Dialogue and perspective.
over-shoulder.detail: shoulder and part of the head visible in frame
over-shoulder.example: over-the-shoulder shot of a warrior watching enemy troops gather in the valley below, shoulder and part of helmet visible in frame, dramatic sunset

orbit-360.name: 360 Orbit Around Subject
orbit-360.does: Circles the subject to show every angle. Builds suspense, power or awe.
orbit-360.example: camera slowly orbits around a levitating sorcerer glowing with energy in a dark cave, magical symbols floating in the air

crane-up.name: Crane Shot Up
crane-up.does: Starts low and rises, revealing the environment. Transcendence, scale.
crane-up.detail: revealing the surroundings as it climbs
crane-up.example: crane shot rising above a knight kneeling in prayer on a battlefield, revealing the ruins around him and a blood-red sky

crane-down.name: Crane Shot Down
crane-down.does: Descends from above into the action. Godlike perspective, destiny.
crane-down.lead: top-down crane shot slowly descending toward
crane-down.example: top-down crane shot slowly descending toward a young girl standing in the center of a glowing ancient rune circle

pan-right.name: Slow Pan Right
pan-right.does: Moves horizontally from a fixed position. Reveals a new environment or shifts subject.
pan-right.example: slow pan right across the rooftops of a medieval city at dawn, smoke rising from chimneys, warm morning light

pov.name: First-Person POV Camera
pov.does: Mimics what a character sees. Deeply immersive.
pov.detail: as if seen through the character's own eyes
pov.example: first-person POV walking into a pyramid chamber lit by torches, dust in the air, ancient hieroglyphs on the walls

top-down.name: Top-Down (Bird's Eye) View
top-down.does: Direct overhead shot. Abstraction, scale, surveillance.
top-down.example: top-down view of a battlefield with soldiers clashing, chaos unfolding below, fog creeping across the field

low-angle.name: Low-Angle Shot
low-angle.does: Looks up at the subject, making them powerful, intimidating, iconic.
low-angle.example: low-angle cinematic shot of a giant robot standing in a city square, sunlight flaring behind its head, people running

high-angle.name: High-Angle Shot
high-angle.does: Looks down at the subject, making them small or vulnerable.
high-angle.example: high-angle shot of a child standing alone in a vast, empty courtyard, snow falling gently

push-in-face.name: Push-In Zoom on Face
push-in-face.does: Moves closer to the face during a realisation or emotional shift.
push-in-face.detail: closing on the face as the expression shifts
push-in-face.example: slow cinematic zoom in on a woman's face as she realizes her lover is gone, tears forming, soft morning light

pull-out-reveal.name: Pull-Out Environmental Reveal
pull-out-reveal.does: Starts close and pulls back to reveal setting or scale. Shocking reveals.
pull-out-reveal.detail: then slowly pulls out to reveal the full scene
pull-out-reveal.example: starts on close-up of a warrior's hand gripping a sword, slowly pulls out to reveal he's surrounded by thousands of enemy troops on a foggy battlefield

wide-static.name: Wide Static Shot with Foreground Movement
wide-static.does: Still camera on the whole environment while something crosses the foreground.
wide-static.detail: the camera holds still while movement crosses the frame
wide-static.example: wide static camera watching a samurai walk past in the foreground with cherry blossoms falling gently, distant temple in background

corner-follow.name: Camera Follows Character Turning a Corner
corner-follow.does: Continuity and flow - exploring a space alongside the character.
corner-follow.detail: tracking as they turn a corner
corner-follow.example: camera follows a thief sneaking through an alley and turning a corner, rain-soaked pavement, flickering neon lights

reveal-behind-object.name: Reveal Shot from Behind an Object
reveal-behind-object.does: Peeks from behind an obstacle to reveal something dramatic.
reveal-behind-object.example: camera slowly peeks from behind a tree to reveal a dragon sleeping in a forest clearing, breath fog rising from its nose

track-alongside.name: Medium Tracking Shot Alongside Character
track-alongside.does: Moves sideways with the subject at medium distance. Motion with focus.
track-alongside.lead: medium tracking shot moving parallel to
track-alongside.example: medium tracking shot moving parallel to a woman running through the desert in slow motion, sand kicking up behind her

tilt-up-approach.name: Upward Tilt While Approaching Subject
tilt-up-approach.does: Begins low, tilts up while closing in. Reveals majesty or scale.
tilt-up-approach.lead: camera tilts upward while moving toward
tilt-up-approach.detail: rising to take in the full height
tilt-up-approach.example: camera tilts upward while moving toward a glowing crystal monolith, shadows flickering on cavern walls

descend-behind.name: Slow Descend Behind Subject from Above
descend-behind.does: Drops from above and settles behind the character to track them.
descend-behind.detail: settling in behind them to follow
descend-behind.example: camera descends from above behind a spaceship pilot walking toward their ship in a hangar, sparks flying from welding droids

over-head-track.name: Over-the-Head Tracking Shot
over-head-track.does: Tracks directly over a character's head as they move through a space.
over-head-track.example: over-the-head camera tracks a knight walking through castle corridors lit by torches, shadows dancing on the walls

through-object.name: Camera Moves Through Object
through-object.does: Passes through a physical object into a new scene. Magical, cinematic.
through-object.detail: crossing into a new space on the other side
through-object.example: camera passes through a mirror and into a fantasy world, transitioning from a bedroom into a floating castle

fall-to-ground.name: First-Person Camera Falls to Ground
fall-to-ground.lead: first-person camera falls to the ground
fall-to-ground.example: first-person camera falls to the ground during a battlefield scene, vision tilted, blurred, and fading

push-through-fog.name: Push Through Fog or Mist
push-through-fog.does: Atmosphere and mystery - the subject emerges as the camera penetrates the haze.
push-through-fog.detail: the haze parting to reveal the subject
push-through-fog.example: camera slowly pushes through thick jungle mist to reveal an ancient stone statue covered in vines

timelapse-pullout.name: Time-Lapse Pull-Out
timelapse-pullout.does: Retreating camera with time passing around it. Epic, magical.
timelapse-pullout.detail: as light shifts and clouds roll past in fast motion
timelapse-pullout.example: camera slowly pulling back from a mountaintop temple as the sun rises and clouds roll over the peaks in fast motion

track-obstructed.name: Tracking Shot with Foreground Obstructions
track-obstructed.does: Follows the subject with objects passing between camera and subject. Realism and depth.
track-obstructed.detail: objects occasionally passing in front of the lens
track-obstructed.example: tracking shot behind a woman walking through a marketplace with people, tents, and fabrics occasionally passing in front of the lens

spiral-object.name: Spiral Around Object on Ground
spiral-object.does: Circles a small item on the ground. Focus and reverence.
spiral-object.example: spiral camera around a glowing magical amulet lying on cracked stone, ancient runes pulsing with light

rising-shoulder-reveal.name: Rising Reveal from Behind Subject's Shoulder
rising-shoulder-reveal.does: Starts low behind, rises and tilts up to reveal what they are looking at.
rising-shoulder-reveal.detail: tilting up to reveal what they see
rising-shoulder-reveal.example: camera slowly rises behind a cloaked figure standing at the edge of a cliff, revealing a massive futuristic city below

reverse-tracking.name: Reverse Tracking (Walking Toward Camera)
reverse-tracking.does: Camera retreats while the subject walks toward it. Emotional focus and pacing.
reverse-tracking.detail: the camera retreating as they walk toward it, eyes locked on the lens
reverse-tracking.example: reverse tracking shot of a man walking slowly through a hallway of flickering lights, eyes locked on the camera

dive-underwater.name: Camera Dives Underwater
dive-underwater.does: Submerges beneath the surface. Transitions, mood shifts, hidden discoveries.
dive-underwater.lead: camera slowly descends from above the surface into
dive-underwater.example: camera slowly descends from above the ocean surface into the deep blue water, bubbles rising, sunlight fading, sea creatures gliding past

follow-into-water.name: Camera Follows Character Into Water
follow-into-water.does: Follows a person as they enter water. Transformation, rebirth, escape.
follow-into-water.detail: continuing as they disappear beneath the surface, ripples and light refraction
follow-into-water.example: camera follows a warrior walking into a sacred lake, then continues following as they disappear beneath the water's surface, ripples and light refraction surrounding them

through-fire.name: Camera Passes Through Fire or Smoke
through-fire.does: Moves through intense elements. Chaos, memory, emergence.
through-fire.detail: the smoke parting to reveal what lies beyond
through-fire.example: camera slowly moves forward through thick smoke and burning debris, revealing a lone firefighter standing in the aftermath of an explosion

through-mirror.name: Camera Moves Through a Mirror or Portal
through-mirror.does: Boundary-crossing effect for magical or sci-fi transitions.
through-mirror.detail: entering the world on the other side
through-mirror.example: camera passes directly through a floating mirror in the forest, entering a glowing realm filled with floating rocks and golden light

surface-from-water.name: Camera Surfaces From Underwater
surface-from-water.does: The reverse of a dive. Rebirth, realisation, escape.
surface-from-water.detail: droplets clinging to the lens as it breaks the surface
surface-from-water.example: camera emerges from beneath murky lake water into a mist-covered landscape, droplets clinging to the lens, revealing a ruined castle in the distance

fall-from-sky.name: Camera Falls From the Sky
fall-from-sky.does: Rapid fall through cloud and wind. Dreams, impact, arrival.
fall-from-sky.lead: camera plummets from the clouds above toward
fall-from-sky.detail: spinning and falling, wind roaring past the lens
fall-from-sky.example: camera plummets from the clouds above, spinning and falling toward a burning battlefield below, wind roaring past the lens

combo-push-tilt.name: Combo: Push-In + Tilt Up
combo-push-tilt.does: Builds emotional intensity and grandeur at the same time.
combo-push-tilt.lead: camera pushes in and tilts up toward
combo-push-tilt.example: camera pushes in and tilts up toward a queen standing on palace stairs as golden banners flow behind her, epic fantasy tone

combo-crane-orbit.name: Combo: Crane Down + Orbit
combo-crane-orbit.does: Sweeping entrance that circles as it descends. Mythic, divine.
combo-crane-orbit.lead: camera cranes down and slowly orbits around
combo-crane-orbit.example: camera cranes down and slowly orbits around a warrior standing on a battlefield surrounded by fallen enemies and lightning in the sky

combo-pov-fall.name: Combo: First-Person + Handheld + Sudden Fall
combo-pov-fall.does: Fully immersive chaotic storytelling. Battle or collapse.
combo-pov-fall.detail: shaking violently, then falling to the ground
combo-pov-fall.example: first-person handheld camera running through a collapsing cave, shaking violently, then falling to the ground as debris crashes down

combo-track-push.name: Combo: Track Behind + Push-In Reveal
combo-track-push.does: Follows the subject, then pushes in to emphasise emotion or a reveal.
combo-track-push.detail: then pushes in as they turn
combo-track-push.example: camera tracks behind a girl walking through a cornfield, then pushes in as she turns and sees a UFO hovering in the sky
